## Summary

Implements ADR 0150 first-release multi-model routing inside the existing provider-independent NativeAgentRuntime. Routing is benchmark-gated against the ADR 0142 single-model baseline, preserves one AgentRun and provider-independent working state, enforces image/capability safety, refuses silent local-to-remote posture changes, records sanitized routing audit events, and exposes measured routing status in AI Studio.

## Validation

Requires Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because AI Studio routing/model-status presentation changes.
